title: Harness must close a task whose acceptance already passes
goal: A roadmap task whose acceptance passes on the untouched base cannot be completed by a worker ladder: the worker can only add an empty commit, so the mission fails on committed false after spending attempts. Precheck the task acceptance after the claim and, when it passes on a clean tree, close the task and publish it instead of running a ladder, with a spec flag so unit tests keep the normal path.
